Project Description: Pharos is an enterprise application used by all DaVita clinics to submit and manage formulary exception requests for medication approval and ordering. A formulary exception refers to a medication or medical product that has restricted usage among patients and therefore requires special approval before it can be prescribed or ordered. Through Pharos, physicians submit exception requests, which are then reviewed and approved by the Clinical Pharmacy Management (CPM) team to ensure compliance with clinical guidelines and patient safety standards.The system streamlines the approval workflow, improves turnaround time, and ensures accurate tracking of approved medications across clinics. The portal collects patient demographics, clinical details, and medical records, and securely shares this information with downstream systems to enable referral processing. It is used by external hospital discharge planners to submit referrals and by DaVita Guest Services (DGS) users to manage operations and assist patients with hospital placement. The project involved the development and enhancement of enterprise-grade digital banking applications for BMO Bank, focusing on secure, high-availability, and scalable systems.
